PrismJS v2 local bundle for LeetHub Topics syntax highlighting.

Source: https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/tree/v2
Snapshot commit: ded4a65b75a246b4dbc6c5a84e584db1078529aa
License: MIT, see LICENSE in this directory.

This bundle intentionally includes only the languages exposed by the
leetcode-cheatsheet topic template dropdown:

- cpp
- java
- javascript
- lua
- python
- ruby

The C and clike language files are included because Prism's C++ grammar depends
on them.
